'''Bozzi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] who ran the [[Lady Yarith]] [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] in the [[Port Town (Cloud City)/Legends|Port Town]] district of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. Bozzi [[Marriage/Legends|married]] during her lifetime, but by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], she was an elderly widow. While at the hotel she allowed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] staff to handle most business while she dozed in a [[Human/Legends|Human]]-sized armchair. During the war when the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Elaiza]] came to Cloud [[City/Legends|City]] in hope of acquiring the [[Jewel of Yavin/Legends|Jewel of Yavin]], a [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gem]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] adopted the persona of a crazy old lady which fooled Bozzi. The Ugnaught took pity on what she saw as a kindred spirit and allowed Elaiza to stay at her hotel with a hefty discount.<ref name="TJoY" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bozzi first appeared in ''[[The Jewel of Yavin]]'', an adventure module released in [[2014]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. she is described as a character players might interact with, although no specific meeting is described.
